title: pvSubdivide
body:
## pvSubdivide

Refines a triangle mesh linearly: each pass splits every triangle into four by adding a point at the midpoint of each edge, so the original surface shape and points are kept exactly while the resolution increases. Use it to give a coarse triangulated surface more points before interpolating onto it, warping or sampling. Input must be polydata of triangles (run triangulate first); use pvLoopSubdivision for a smoothed surface.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Each pass quadruples the triangle count; four passes give 256 times as many triangles.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Subdivide`. Identity: `filters/Subdivide`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This parameter specifies the input to the Subdivide filter. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |

| `NumberofSubdivisions` | The value of this property specifies the number of subdivision iterations to perform. | `{"maximum":4,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
